notes.new_features: NEW: Automatic system information collection! Auto-fill device details with system-info-collector.py script
improvements: Autonomous system-info-collector.py script for Windows, macOS, and Linux
Auto-fill device inventory (brand, model, serial, RAM, CPU, disk, antivirus, installed software)
New /api/device-info endpoint for direct system info submission
Enhanced network scan with optional WMI enrichment for Windows machines
Intelligent device matching by MAC address, IP, or hostname

features.collector: Download system-info-collector.py and run on each machine to auto-fill inventory
features.scan_enrichment: Network scan now supports optional WMI enrichment for detailed Windows system info
features.mdns: Still supports mDNS access via http://parcinfo.local:3456
